verses.1: And Shimehon descended into the valley. There he saw a woman who was one of the daughters of Philistia.
verses.2: And he went up and told his father and mother. He said, “A woman has seen me with her daughters among the daughters of Philistia. Now, take her for me as a wife.”
verses.3: And his father and mother said to him, “Is there no woman among your relatives or among all the nations around you? You are going to take a wife from those loveless women.” Then Shemson said to his father, “Please give her to me, for she is pure in my eyes.”
verses.4: And his father and mother did not know that it was from Jehovah that this was coming. For in that time, the Philistines were being destroyed in Israel.
verses.5: And Shimehon and his father and mother came to Timnah. They arrived at the vineyards of Timnah. There, they saw a lion roaring at their call.
verses.6: And the Spirit of Jehovah entered into him, and he was seized up with pain. He had no power to do anything, nor could he tell his father and mother what he had done.
verses.7: And he went down and spoke to the woman. Then she stood up in front of the sun.
verses.8: And from those days onward, he would go to take it. He would also go to see the cub of the lion. And there, in the forest where the lion lived, there were also trees and bushes.
verses.9: And he went down to his knees. He ate and drank, then went to his father and mother. He gave them something to eat. But he didn’t tell them that the fig leaves came from the land of the lion.
verses.10: And his father went down to the woman, and there he made a sun to drink from it. For so will those who are chosen do.
verses.11: And when they saw him, they took thirty of their enemies and became his followers.
verses.12: And Shimon said to them, “I will give you a puzzle. If you can solve it within seven days, I will give you thirty skins and thirty coats of skin.”
verses.13: And if you cannot tell me, then give me thirty sets of clothes and thirty pairs of shoes. They said to him, “Your riddle has been heard.”
verses.14: And he said to them, “From what they ate, there was food; from what they drank, there was drink. But they couldn’t tell the secret for three days.”
verses.15: And on the seventh day, they said to Ashkenaz’ wife, “I will take your husband and give him to you as a gift. Then he will tell us the secret. Otherwise, we will destroy you and your family in our fire. Please call us here.”
verses.16: And the daughter of Shemashon covered him with fire. She said, “Only love me, and do not hate me.” But she did not show any love for me. He said to her, “Look, I have already told my father and mother nothing about this. But I will tell you now.”
verses.17: And she remained on him for seven days, during which time he was unable to drink. On the seventh day, he told her that she had hurt him. Then she told the children of his people the secret.
verses.18: And the people of the city said to him on the seventh day, before the destroyer came from the forest and from the wilderness. They said to him, “Do you not understand? You haven’t solved my mystery yet.”
verses.19: And the spirit of Jehovah came upon him. Ashkelon went down from them, and thirty men were taken away by him. He gave their replacements to those who were responsible for the tasks. Then he cut off his hair and went up to his father’s house.
verses.20: And the daughter of Shimshon became his enemy, because she was his enemy.
